meta.title: Retry with backoff and DLQ
meta.summary: A failing message is retried with growing delays, then parked in a dead-letter queue.

steps.title: Attempt 1 fails
steps.narration: The worker pulls a message and calls the partner API. It fails, so the worker waits **1s** before retrying.

steps.title: Attempt 2 fails
steps.narration: Same failure. The delay doubles to **2s**. Exponential backoff gives the partner time to recover.

steps.title: Attempt 3 fails
steps.narration: Third failure with a **4s** delay. Adding random jitter in real systems stops all workers retrying in lockstep.

steps.title: Park in the DLQ
steps.narration: Retries are exhausted. Rather than loop forever, the worker moves the message to the **dead-letter queue** for a human to inspect.

steps.title: Retry succeeds
steps.narration: This time the partner answers. The message is acknowledged and never reaches the DLQ.
